interview_answer.description: Open-ended interview-style answer evaluated by AI
interview_answer.notes: Already supported by scenario runtime. Add BA-specific rubric.

single_choice.notes: New activity type. Needs Activity model with type discriminator. Store options + correct answer in data JSON.

multiple_choice.notes: Same as single_choice but answer is an array. Deterministic set comparison.

numeric.description: Numeric input question with exact/tolerance match
numeric.notes: Simple number input. Store correct value + optional tolerance.

free_text.description: Free-text answer with optional keyword pre-check and AI evaluation
free_text.notes: Platform already supports textarea-based answers via scenario runtime. Add keyword configuration for hybrid evaluation.

drag_sort.notes: New activity type. Items array + correct order array. Frontend component uses @dnd-kit.

drag_group.notes: Items + group definitions + correct assignment mapping.

matching.description: Match left column items to right column items
matching.notes: Pairs of left/right. User matches via dropdown. Score by correct pair count.

fill_blanks.description: Fill in blanks within a template text
fill_blanks.notes: Template with {blankN} placeholders. Each blank has optional options dropdown. Correct answers array.

click_image.description: Click on a zone within an image to answer
click_image.notes: Image URL + zone coordinates + correct zone ID. Unused in source but component exists.

table_input.notes: Column definitions + row labels. User fills cells.

branching_dialogue.notes: Node-based dialogue graph. User picks options. Final evaluation by path taken.

interactive_board.notes: Zones with items that can be moved between them.

flashcard.notes: Front text + back text. User self-assesses. Always recorded as attempted.

likert.notes: Scale values with labels. Collects user confidence/agreement.

diagnostic_assessment.description: Multi-question diagnostic that determines user level
diagnostic_assessment.notes: Bundled activity: sequence of sub-questions with level calculation algorithm.

exam.notes: Time-limited session with random question selection, sequential delivery, score aggregation, pass threshold.

deterministic.notes: New DeterministicValidator service. Stateless function. Can run server-side or client-side.

ai.notes: Already implemented via AIGatewayService. Add BA-specific prompts and rubrics.

hybrid.description: Two-phase: keyword pre-check then AI quality evaluation
hybrid.notes: New orchestration layer combining deterministic + AI in sequence.

schema_extensions_required.description: Add activity_type field to Scenario or new Activity model
schema_extensions_required.impact: Schema change required. New column or table.
schema_extensions_required.notes: Optional field with default null — existing QA scenarios unaffected.

schema_extensions_required.description: Add optional deterministic result to Attempt model
schema_extensions_required.impact: New column or new simple_evaluations table
schema_extensions_required.notes: Existing Attempt model untouched. New nullable FK or separate table.

schema_extensions_required.description: Exam-specific session model with timer and sequential delivery
schema_extensions_required.notes: Does not affect existing simulation sessions.
Fully optional. Can use existing metadata_json as alternative.

compatibility_with_existing_QA_trainer.notes: All extensions are additive (new tables or nullable columns). Existing QA trainer scenarios, attempts, evaluations, and progress are not affected.
